package config

import (
	"errors"

	"github.com/kelseyhightower/envconfig"
)

// Config holds environment configuration for service.
type Config struct {
	HTTPHost                       string `envconfig:"HTTP_HOST" default:""`
	HTTPPort                       string `envconfig:"HTTP_PORT" default:"8080"`
	DatabaseURL                    string `envconfig:"DATABASE_URL" default:"postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/mc_course?sslmode=disable"`
	NATSURL                        string `envconfig:"NATS_URL" default:"nats://localhost:4222"`
	InternalAPIToken               string `envconfig:"INTERNAL_API_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	LearningPlannerInternalToken   string `envconfig:"LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:""`
	DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken string `envconfig:"DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:""`
	TaskAnswerServiceBaseURL       string `envconfig:"TASK_ANSWER_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8081"`
	TaskAnswerServiceInternalToken string `envconfig:"TASK_ANSWER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	FileStorageServiceBaseURL      string `envconfig:"FILESTORAGE_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8088"`
	FileStorageInternalToken       string `envconfig:"FILESTORAGE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:""`
	ShutdownTimeout                int    `envconfig:"SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT" default:"10"`
}

// Load reads environment variables into Config.
func Load() (Config, error) {
	var cfg Config
	if err := envconfig.Process("", &cfg); err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	if cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken != "" &&
		cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken == cfg.InternalAPIToken {
		return Config{}, errors.New("LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN must differ from INTERNAL_API_TOKEN")
	}
	if cfg.DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken != "" &&
		(cfg.DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken == cfg.InternalAPIToken || cfg.DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken == cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken) {
		return Config{}, errors.New("DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN must differ from other internal tokens")
	}
	return cfg, nil
}
